international.summary: Party says there will be 12 debates to select a candidate from what is expected to be a large number of hopefuls Sign up to the Breaking News US email Donald Trump has praised the “correct and proper decision” of Nvidia ’s board of directors to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive, saying both the company and the country “needs” Huang’s leadership. Huang resigned on 12 November after revelations ​of extramarital affairs, including one with a businesswoman US authorities suspect of spying for China. A similar dinner in May 2025 drew interest from crypto moguls and others seeking an audience with Trump, with would-be guests competing for 220 open seats. But since that gathering, the coin’s value has plummeted by around 90%, and the event struggled to fill 185 seats , even though it is now cheaper to buy the meme coin and qualify. The $TRUMP cryptocurrency briefly commanded a paper valuation exceeding $14bn in January 2025, around the time of the president’s second inauguration. Its per-coin peak was around $74. It now trades below $1 , leaving hundreds of thousands of small investors with steep losses while Trump-affiliated entities collected hundreds of millions of dollars in fees and token sales.
